= Table roles

.Single arbitrary role
[.brand,width=45%]
|===
|Brand |A wider second cell
|===

.Multiple arbitrary roles
[.brand.audit,width=45%]
|===
|Brand and audit |A wider second cell
|===

.Arbitrary role before a placement role
[.brand.center,width=45%]
|===
|Brand then center |A wider second cell
|===

.Arbitrary role after a placement role
[.center.brand,width=45%]
|===
|Center then brand |A wider second cell
|===

.Arbitrary role with stretch
[.brand.stretch%autowidth]
|===
|Brand and stretch |A deliberately wider second cell
|===
